data.body: Correction to the earlier comment's count: the script has **17** `/var/lib/rebar` defaults, not 16. My first census used the pattern `[A-Z_]+`, which cannot match `G2P_OFFSET_FILE` (it contains a digit). Re-counted against all 17, the 19 whole-script test files leave these many unset: coldstart_e2a6 8, container_layers 6, data_disk_debris 6, disk_pressure 4, docker_storage 6, exit 12, interrupt_reasons 8, journal 6, journal_bounding_1205 4, marker_anchor_8c2f 8, mcp_health_9ea3 10, mcp_markers 5, memory_9ea3 10, mirror_sync_bff5 10, offsets_6a65 10, reviewbot_webhook_auth 15, rotation_2dc7 10, timeout_9313 5, var_tmp 6. Plan revised after review-plan run 1 (BLOCK on this count): the helper derives the set from the script rather than hard-coding a number, and redirects `INSTANCE_ID_CACHE` (line 73, derived from REGION_CACHE's directory) explicitly.
